records.detail: agent/agent.py:196 is the Native Engine's Bash tool: running the shell command the model chose is the documented purpose of a one-file coding agent (docs/configuration.md lists AGENT_BASH_TIMEOUT and the closed stdin). The docs advertise no approval step or sandbox, so no stated boundary goes unenforced.

ci.yml x2 and docs.yml x5 pin actions by tag (checkout@v4, setup-python@v5, configure-pages@v5, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4). docs.yml holds pages:write + id-token:write; neither workflow uses pull_request_target. scorecard.yml, added in the scanned commit, already SHA-pins all four of its actions with a version comment, so the project has written the fix in a sibling file.

Every URL is a constant, a loopback port or operator config: agent.py:733 AGENT_BASE_URL, keepgoing.py:84 the hardcoded OpenRouter models endpoint, keepgoing.py:107 and router.py:120/136 127.0.0.1 health checks, limit-handoff.py:103 MOONSTONE_URL (default loopback), router.py:220 the client's request path appended to a fixed loopback backend. No request- or model-controlled URL reaches urlopen, so file:// never can.
router.py:120 is plain http to 127.0.0.1:4000/health, a loopback hop with no network to encrypt.
scripts/limit-handoff.py:81 sha1(cwd)[:16] names a per-folder stamp file for the hand-off quiet period; a non-security identifier, not a password, MAC or signature.
setup.sh:33 runs Homebrew's official installer, only when brew is absent; that is the vendor's own documented install line, fetched over HTTPS with curl -fsSL.

proxy/server.py (127.0.0.1:4000) and the experimental smart-router/router.py (127.0.0.1:4010, started by no launcher) check neither Host nor Origin and parse a text/plain body as JSON, so a web page can send them CORS-simple POSTs. Impact is bounded to compute: inference on the proxy, forced model swaps on the router. Nothing is readable cross-origin (no CORS headers), every shell string in the router is built from constants, and the 127.0.0.1 bind keeps the LAN out. A Host allowlist plus refusing requests that carry a browser Origin would close it.
